patch_description: Replace random points with a deterministic optimizer: initialize candidates from a 3-fold symmetric triangular configuration plus perturbed lattice seeds, then run multi-start local refinement that maximizes the smallest normalized triangle area. Use logsumexp smoothing over the 286 triangle areas, project points back into the unit-area regular triangle hull each step, and apply a lexicographic tie-break preferring larger hull coverage. Fixed seed ensures determinism.
